_comment: DSP of the audio core (modules/audio), 48 kHz. Sectioned by OUTPUT — see docs/CONCEPT.md, "Outputs". Two DACs are planned, giving four modes picked from the menu: 2.0 (DAC 1 only), biamp, 4.0 and 2.1. The shape is fixed now so saved presets never need migrating. TODAY only section 0 is loaded and only mode 2.0 runs; everything else is declared, not implemented. Band type: peak | lowshelf | highshelf | lowpass | highpass | notch; f in Hz, gain in dB, q. Edit, then toggle audio.eq_reload.

crossover._comment: Linkwitz-Riley 24 dB/oct = two cascaded Butterworths (q 0.707) at one frequency. Unused in 2.0.

outputs.label: ДРУГИЙ ЦАП
outputs._comment: Silent until there is a second DAC. Its meaning follows `mode`: the other way in biamp, the second pair in 4.0, the subwoofer in 2.1.
